evidence: Data/model/prior-run source hashes checked; 22 selected origins and 286 saved optimization records.
Unchanged SEIR-SEI equations/bounds; training-only fixed-scale profiles; three declared near-optimal thresholds.
No model selected by future observation errors.
A2 n23, N_eff=1000000 profile independently repeated with training SSE delta=0 and four-week forecast delta=0.
32 profiles, 128 optimization attempts, 66 near-optimal summaries and four local Jacobian diagnostics.
Both diagnostic PNGs inspected; PDF counterparts saved; ranges explicitly not confidence intervals.
All selected profile fits converged; maximum step-halving reference difference below 6.2e-9.
State sums, nonnegativity and target indexing tested.
Code inspection: profile worker receives only y[:n], no evaluation targets; selected initialization comes from the same origin.
Evaluation uses known development data and is explicitly retrospective.
Linear growth characteristic polynomial and product-preserving ratio changes independently checked.

findings: Large parameter variation does not imply large forecast dispersion at the same origin; origin23 near-optimal forecasts all overpredict.
Updating from origin23 to origin24 changes effective scale and reconstructed states sharply.
Finite profile searches and finite-difference Jacobians do not prove global optimality or structural non-identifiability.
Climate causation is not established. Single-temperature direction was subsequently approved, but climate model has not been fitted.
verdict_scope: Retrospective diagnostic implementation; not a final predictive or causal claim.
